title: University House Aobayama
description: Four seasons of stunning views captured while living at University House Aobayama, the international student dormitory of Tohoku University in Sendai

images.alt: Night sky seen from the dorm late at night
images.description: May 31, 2022 — I dimmed the lights in my dorm late at night, and the sky outside the window had such depth that I felt like I was living in the universe.

images.alt: Dawn glow in the small hours
images.description: June 13, 2022 — in a Sendai summer the sky brightens early: before 3 a.m. it was already growing light, and by 3:35 a faint dawn glow had appeared.

images.alt: Stratocumulus seen from the University House Aobayama common room
images.description: July 9, 2022 — early summer. Stratocumulus spread across the sky, and lush green filled the whole campus. A view from the common room of University House Aobayama.

images.alt: A road through the Aobayama forest in the rain
images.description: July 13, 2022 — the back gate of University House Aobayama leads to a road through the Aobayama forest. Walking in the rain and breathing in the fresh forest air, I felt surrounded by untouched nature.

images.alt: A foggy early morning
images.description: July 17, 2022 — a foggy early morning, just as the sky was beginning to lighten.

images.alt: Scud clouds hanging over the campus after rain
images.description: July 23, 2022 — after the rain, low scud clouds hung over the campus. A view from my room window. The colors of summer are so rich.

images.alt: A summer sunset seen from the common room
images.description: August 2, 2022 — a summer sunset seen from the common room.

images.alt: A sunset glow with exceptional visibility, the Pacific in the distance
images.description: August 3, 2022 — a sunset glow seen from my dorm window on a day of exceptional visibility; the Pacific Ocean in the distance was remarkably clear.

images.alt: The lush green campus outside my dorm window
images.description: August 16, 2022 — outside my dorm window, the campus was lush and green.

images.alt: Sunset glow seen from the common room
images.description: August 16, 2022 — a sunset glow of pink and orange filled the whole sky.

images.alt: The blood-red campus in light mist before dawn
images.description: September 1, 2022, 4:49 a.m. — I looked out my dorm window: the mist-shrouded campus had turned a blood red so vivid it seemed like another world. I could hardly trust my own eyes.

images.alt: The blood-red campus in light mist before dawn
images.description: September 1, 2022, 4:50 a.m. — I looked out my dorm window: the mist-shrouded campus had turned a blood red so vivid it seemed like another world. I could hardly trust my own eyes.

images.alt: A path into the Aobayama forest
images.description: September 17, 2022 — through the back gate of University House Aobayama, I stepped onto a small path into the Aobayama forest.

images.alt: Wooden steps under the cedar shade
images.description: September 17, 2022 — out the back gate and into the Aobayama forest. As I climbed the wooden steps, the light coming through the cedars grew softer with every step.

images.alt: Early autumn seen from the common room balcony
images.description: November 3, 2022 — the same view, this time from the common room balcony. The pines were still deep green, but the trees around had quietly begun to take on autumn colors.

images.alt: Late autumn seen from the common room balcony
images.description: November 16, 2022 — from the common room balcony. Autumn had deepened: red maples covered the hillside, and the distant ridges layered one behind another in the light breaking through the clouds.

images.alt: A dim yellow glow on a rainy autumn night
images.description: November 23, 2022 — a night of steady autumn rain. Sky and road alike were bathed in a dim yellow glow.

images.alt: Winter fog in the midnight moonlight
images.description: December 8, 2022 — the small woods behind the dorm, winter fog adrift in the midnight moonlight.

images.alt: Winter cumulus clouds in front of the dorm
images.description: December 13, 2022 — winter cumulus clouds towering in front of the dorm, bringing no rain yet, turning the evening light a murky yellow.

images.alt: Snow-covered trees in silver
images.description: December 14, 2022 — on the slope leading up to University House Aobayama, the trees glittered in a coat of silver, and the snow glowed faintly blue beneath the streetlight. A hushed, fairy-tale world.

images.alt: Unmelted snow on the slope at night
images.description: December 17, 2022 — the slope leading up to the dorm, the snow still unmelted. Against the deep blue of night, the leftover snow glimmered faintly under the streetlights.

images.alt: Freezing fog outside my dorm window
images.description: December 19, 2022 — freezing fog outside my dorm window. Sky and earth alike were wrapped in a boundless white.

images.alt: The city in night and the Pacific dawn glow
images.description: December 20, 2022, 6:08 a.m. — the city in the distance still dark, while a fiery sunrise glow burned over the Pacific.

images.alt: First sunlight on the campus buildings, mist over the mountains
images.description: December 20, 2022, 7:00 a.m. — the first rays of morning sun were already falling on the campus buildings, while mist wreathed the distant mountains.

images.alt: Withered winter grass and a clear sky
images.description: December 30, 2022 — near the dorm, a field of withered winter grass stretched out under a clear blue sky dotted with small, fair-weather cumulus clouds.

images.alt: The snow-covered experimental area like a Nordic village
images.description: January 25, 2023, 5:21 p.m. — after a night of heavy snow, the greenhouses of the experimental area looked like a small Nordic village. From the common room balcony, the sky held that blue-gray dusk light, the streetlights melting warm yellow circles into the snow, and the distant mountains sat heavy against the horizon.

images.alt: The campus late at night after heavy snow
images.description: January 26, 2023, 1:43 a.m. — below the slope leading to University House Aobayama after a heavy snow. Thick snow blanketed the whole campus, making me feel, truly, this is Sendai.

images.alt: The snow-covered road to the dorm
images.description: January 26, 2023, 1:47 a.m. — the road leading to University House Aobayama. Thick snow blanketed everything, making me feel, truly, this is Sendai.

images.alt: Heavy snow on the slope to the dorm
images.description: February 10, 2023 — the slope leading up to University House Aobayama was engulfed in heavy snow, with accumulations reaching around 30 cm.
